title: A NEW Trace! The FULL MH370 Story, so Far..
summary: Mentour Pilot's 56-minute account of the MH370 disappearance and what is now known, including the WSPR radio tracking technique and other sensing methods. It was made ahead of renewed search efforts.
why: HN recommends it as a detailed, pilot's-eye summary of the whole MH370 story and the case for searching again.

quote.text: I highly recommend Mentour Pilots videos on the topic, for an indepth introduction to the whole story and the new search
